page_title: AUG 2-3 MAI | Augsburg v Mainz 20/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's it for today, Soren Storks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+12' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+11' Although Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is just on the bench, Soren Storks has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+11' The Augsburg players are stunned as referee Soren Storks changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
90+8' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Augsburg as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
90+7' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Silvan Widmer (Mainz) gets booked.
90+7' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. The referee gives a penalty kick to Augsburg!!
90+6' Arne Maier (Augsburg) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
90+3' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+1' Steve Mounie (Augsburg) is quickest inside the box and jumps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it flies just wide of the right post.
90+1' Augsburg have a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

90' Steve Mounie (Augsburg) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Robin Zentner is well positioned and easily deals with the effort. Augsburg get a corner.
89' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
88' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) replacing Jonathan Burkardt.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Silvan Widmer (Mainz) comes onto the pitch so that Anthony Caci can be given a rest.
87' That's unlucky! Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
84' Yellow card. Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
84' Augsburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
80' Substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj makes his way off the pitch and Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
80' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg) replaces Marius Wolf.
79' Augsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
78' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
72' Here is a change. Ruben Vargas is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
72' Mainz are ruled offside.
71' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Soren Storks saw the whole situation.
70' RED card! Samuel Essende (Augsburg) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

69' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Samuel Essende (Augsburg), but referee Soren Storks must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
68' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
68' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Robin Zentner (Mainz). The ball goes out of play and Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
63' Bo Henriksen has decided to substitute Hyun-Seok Hong and he is replaced by Maxim Leitsch (Mainz).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Arne Maier (Augsburg) replaces Kristijan Jakic.
60' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
57' 2 - 3 Samuel Essende (Augsburg) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.
56' Bo Henriksen isn't happy on the touchline after referee Soren Storks shows him a yellow card.

55' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Robin Zentner is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
52' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
52' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
49' 1 - 3 Goal! Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball inside the back of the net.
49' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mainz.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Augsburg comes to nothing.
47' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
46' Half-time substitution. Jess Thorup decided to make a change. Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) is replaced by Steve Mounie.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Soren Storks has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

42' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.
39' Bo Henriksen is forced to make a tactical change due to a red card. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) will be replaced by Aymen Barkok.
35' RED CARD! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Soren Storks. He can have an early bath.
33' A yellow card for bad language! Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.

30' What an opportunity! Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
28' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
28' Soren Storks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz). It's a free kick to Augsburg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
27' The corner is swung in but Augsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
27' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net, but Robin Zentner shows his agility and makes a save.
25' 1 - 2 Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets low into the middle of the goal.
25' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) makes a rough challenge and Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. Augsburg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
22' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.

21' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
21' Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul after Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) hacks down one of his opponents. Mainz win a free kick.
17' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

15' 0 - 2 Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) strikes with a perfect low header inside the left post after a brilliant cross! He found himself unmarked and nodded the ball past the goalkeeper. Brilliant finish!
13' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Armindo Sieb (Mainz) does well to meet a cross inside the box and powers a header past the helpless goalkeeper.

9' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
9' Soren Storks interrupts the game. One of the players from Augsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Mainz in a dangerous position.
7' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) is penalised for holding. Soren Storks signals a set piece.
6' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
4' The Augsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Soren Storks got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
